equations: z = W^H y = A s + n_prime
model.representation: receiver retains K effective-channel coefficients per row; all N observations and symbols remain

hypotheses.reproducibility: the declared OFDM-initialized procedure yields a consistent favorable-regime advantage across five independent seeds
hypotheses.tail_ablation: tail continuation improves communication beyond a channel-draw-matched mean-only continuation
hypotheses.operational: Learned retains a qualified advantage against validation-selected slope-1-inclusive classical receivers
hypotheses.complexity: Learned reaches predeclared BER targets with lower declared detector or receiver-processing cost
hypotheses.failure: absence of paired confirmatory support, unfavorable seed dispersion, unattained BER targets, or savings confined to incomplete accounting

banks.derivation: SHA-256(namespace='pub1f-v1', role, semantic fields), first 63 bits; list positions excluded
banks.pairing: common channels, symbols, and physical-domain noise across waveforms, K, receivers, and continuation arms where mathematically applicable

training.projection: SVD polar projection after every update
training.tail_continuation_selection: lowest checkpoint-validation CVaR_0.95 among checkpoints with mean MSE <= 1.02 times that seed's selected parent mean MSE; tie-break mean MSE then step
training.optimizer_state_policy: both arms clone the selected parent waveform and fresh Adam state; paired continuation draws
training.historical_difference: fresh continuation streams are used instead of Stage-1A.2's historical stream sequence

receivers.residual_aware: waveform/channel-family/K/support-policy-specific omitted mean and dense receive covariance from independent bank; no conditioning on realized retained values/support

afdm.selection_granularity: condition, modulation, SNR, K, receiver family
afdm.adaptation: labels and channel family known; no realized-channel or test adaptation
afdm.tie_break: lower BER, then lower analytic MSE, then smaller slope

early_gate.passes_if: for joint_0.5 QPSK and 16QAM, Learned BER is lower than every validation-selected classical alternative and each paired 95% upper bound is below zero
early_gate.failure_action: stop expensive training; finish independent infrastructure and report

complexity.real_flop_conversion: one complex MAC = 8 real FLOPs only when explicitly shown; comparisons retain primitive counts

statistics.aggregate_ber: total errors divided by total tested bits
statistics.training_seed_summary: median and full five-seed range; seed variability separate from channel interval
statistics.zero_error_display: Jeffreys display estimate only; raw counts authoritative
